# OOP Arcade - Production Build

This is the production-ready build of OOP Arcade board games collection.

## Features
- All JavaScript files are minified and obfuscated
- Optimized for performance
- Ready for deployment

## Games Included
1. Tic Tac Toe
2. Four in a Row
3. Numerical Tic Tac Toe
4. SUS Game
5. Misere Tic Tac Toe
6. Word Tic Tac Toe
7. 4x4 Tic Tac Toe
8. 5x5 Tic Tac Toe
9. Obstacle Tic Tac Toe
10. Diamond Tic Tac Toe
11. Timed Tic Tac Toe

## Technology Stack
- Pure HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+)
- No frameworks or dependencies
- Fully client-side

## Deployment
This build is ready to be deployed to any static hosting service:
- Netlify
- GitHub Pages
- Vercel
- AWS S3
- Any web server

Simply upload all files to your hosting service.
